title: Limitations and AI use
text:
# Limitations and AI-use statements

**Draft, 22 October 2026. Human verification pending.**

## Main-text limitations

The India–Pakistan results are conditional spending scenarios. The Indian anchor is an external modeled estimate with an unstated price and valuation basis; the analysis assumes nominal 2022 rupees and retail value. Pakistan lacks a comparable verified national baseline in the retained evidence. Proxy coefficients and distributions are analyst choices, with possible overlap among income, urbanisation, animal-protein supply and industry activity. The reported simulation percentiles have no demonstrated probability coverage. Macro projections beyond 2031 extend the last available growth rates. The US comparison uses a different product basket and a 2025 observation rather than a matched forecast-year benchmark. National supply, stated intention, paid purchase, repeat purchase and animal-food displacement remain different outcomes. The source collection is selective and does not establish that evidence absent from this collection is absent everywhere.

The separate model-elicitation supplement is a repetition and disagreement exercise under recorded workflows. Its regional prompts, evidence conditioning, execution dates, tools and technology scope can differ from other contributors' studies. Model versions and attempted-run selection also matter. The accepted set excludes rejected and errored attempts, and a parser rule changed during collection. The spread of run medians is not a predictive interval. Similar answers do not prove calibration or independent evidence; different answers do not isolate the effect of a model, prompt or AI assumption. The supplement is authored as Umar's work and is not represented as an accepted joint result.

## Current, truthful AI-use statement

AI tools assisted source discovery and summarization, code development, quantitative scenario construction, structured forecast elicitation, and drafting/editing. The separate elicitation requested `gpt-6-astra` and `claude-opus-5-5`; provider identity evidence is reported in its methods rather than assumed. Codex assisted this 22 October writing and methodological audit, including inspection of retained calculations and execution receipts. The human author's scope choices and approvals are recorded separately from factual verification. Human verification of the included claims, citations, statistics, quotations, datasets and code is pending. These materials are review drafts and must not be represented as final or accepted programme outputs.

This statement describes known workflow categories. Before final submission, the human author must complete a tool/version/task register for substantive earlier AI use as well; this drafting pass cannot certify the full historical record.

## Final statement template — do not use until completed

> AI assistance was used for [verified list of tools and substantive tasks]. [Named humans] checked [scope and dated review records], including the cited originals, numerical transformations and executable code. Remaining limitations are reported in [locations]. [Insert the programme's required attestation only after it is true.]

The programme policy requires human verification of **all** included AI-produced or AI-edited claims, citations, statistics, quotations, datasets and code. Prioritize load-bearing claims, but do not narrow the requirement to those claims alone. Code review includes reading, running and testing. Agent checks do not substitute for human review. Scholarly peer review may remain pending and labelled after factual/code verification; that label is not an alternative to verification.

Private review drafts may retain explicitly marked unverified material for review. Final submission/public release must omit it or complete the verification. Source: Sentient Futures Project Incubator AI Use Policy, 20 August 2026, Verification, Transparency and Attestation sections. The policy document is not bundled; participants should consult their programme copy.

## Human review register fields

Claim ID; exact manuscript sentence/table; original-source locator; source vintage; numerical transformation/code revision; reviewer name; review date; disposition (verified/corrected/omit/unresolved); restrictions; author sign-off. A blank reviewer field remains pending. No reviewer identity or approval is inferred from possession of a file.
